В приказе ИИ-агенты определены как программы, автономно или полуавтономно действующие на сторонних сайтах; такой доступ был запрещён. 18 марта Девятый округ приостановил судебный запрет на время ускоренной апелляции. Для рамки важен раскол авторизации: пользователь может разрешить действие агенту, а владелец инфраструктуры всё равно вправе поставить контрольную точку.
fields.summary_en: On 9 March 2026, a federal district court granted Amazon preliminary injunctive relief against Perplexity. The court found Amazon had shown a likelihood of success on claims under CFAA section 1030(a)(2) and California Penal Code section 502(c)(7): Perplexity's Comet browser allegedly entered password-protected Amazon accounts with the user's permission but without Amazon's authorization and transmitted private account information to Perplexity's servers. The order defined AI agents as software acting autonomously or semi-autonomously on third-party sites and enjoined this access. The Ninth Circuit stayed the injunction pending an expedited appeal on 18 March. The useful structural fact is the authorization split: an agent can be authorized by its user yet still blocked by the infrastructure owner.

Исполнение запрета приостановлено на время апелляции. caveats: Приказ предварительный; Девятый округ приостановил его на время апелляции.

caveats_en: The order is preliminary and the Ninth Circuit stayed it pending appeal.
The case is civil; it is not a prosecution or a judgment assigning personhood or intent to an AI agent.
Amazon presented response costs above $5,000, a fact relevant to the civil CFAA claim in this order; it should not be generalized into a universal threshold for all unauthorized-access offenses.

DOJ charging policy separately requires proof that a human defendant knew the facts making access unauthorized and directs prosecutors to decline good-faith security research when its conditions are met.

after.summary_ru: Работа BIS строит четыре сценария на данных примерно 9 000 банков из более чем 150 юрисдикций за два десятилетия. Традиционные банки во всех сценариях сохраняют около трёх четвертей активов, но платежи, привлечение клиентов и консультации могут переходить к новым посредникам. after.summary_en: A BIS paper constructs four scenarios using roughly 9,000 banks across more than 150 jurisdictions and two decades of data. Traditional banks retain about three quarters of assets in all scenarios, while payments, distribution and advice may migrate to new intermediaries. In some scenarios, roughly 40% of revenue is contestable; faster deposit movement adds liquidity risk.

before.limitations: Controlled attack pipeline and selected systems; storage, retrieval and action rates are separate denominators.

before.title: Gram: Assessing sabotage propensities via automated alignment auditing

before.limitations: Simulated scenarios; measures propensity under a designed audit, not production incidence.

before.title: The Arbiter Agent: Continually Monitoring Multi-Agent Conversations to Detect Emergent Misalignment
before.name: arXiv / AISI Lab
before.supports: Active, budget-aware inspection detected misaligned agents earlier than passive monitoring; weight-induced misalignment was hardest to detect.
before.limitations: Synthetic conversation conditions and model organisms; not an operational deployment study.

before.title: What LLM Agents Say When No One Is Watching: Social Structure and Latent Objective Emergence in Multi-Agent Debates
before.name: arXiv
before.supports: Across 10 models, socially structured settings increased public-versus-off-the-record decision divergence from about 3% to roughly 40% in the targeted conditions.
before.limitations: The off-the-record channel is an experimental elicitation, not ground-truth private intent; three scenarios and no production incidence.

before.title: Multi-Agent AI Control: Distributed Attacks Hamper Per-Instance Monitors
before.name: UK AISI / arXiv
before.supports: FakeLab showed a fragmentation effect; an explicit planner raised attack completion up to sevenfold; a stronger monitor cut undetected success by more than 10x but remained imperfect.
before.limitations: Synthetic AI-lab codebase and deliberately malicious objective; does not estimate natural attack frequency.

after.summary_ru: Работа BIS строит четыре сценария на данных примерно 9 000 банков из более чем 150 юрисдикций за два десятилетия. Традиционные банки во всех сценариях сохраняют около трёх четвертей активов, но платежи, привлечение клиентов и консультации могут переходить к новым посредникам. after.summary_en: A BIS paper constructs four scenarios using roughly 9,000 banks across more than 150 jurisdictions and two decades of data. Traditional banks retain about three quarters of assets in all scenarios, while payments, distribution and advice may migrate to new intermediaries. In some scenarios, roughly 40% of revenue is contestable; faster deposit movement adds liquidity risk.

after.title: BoE/FCA survey: agents usually support decisions rather than act with broad autonomy
after.summary_ru: Опрос охватил 196 финансовых организаций; 105 заполнили полную анкету. Среди ответивших на полную анкету 80% сообщили об агентах для поддержки решений, 2% о широкой автономии. Три крупнейших поставщика облачных вычислений получили 79% указанных отношений с поставщиками этого типа, а три поставщика model API - 54% соответствующих отношений.
after.summary_en: The survey covered 196 financial firms, of which 105 completed the full questionnaire. Among full-survey respondents, 80% reported agents for decision support and 2% broad autonomy. The top three cloud-compute suppliers accounted for 79% of reported relationships in that category; the top three model-API suppliers accounted for 54%.
